game.title: Napoleon: Total War
game.blurb: Strategy game from Creative Assembly (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive), published by SEGA, released 2010-02-23. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Strategy. Strategy games have no story chapters, so these chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes: the Italian, Egypt and Europe campaigns, the Peninsular Campaign, historical battles, campaign feats, battles and multiplayer.

chapters.title: Italian Campaign
chapters.summary: Winning the Italian Campaign on easy, on medium within historic time, and on hard.

chapters.title: Egypt Campaign
chapters.summary: Winning the Egypt Campaign on each difficulty, and as the Ottomans.

chapters.title: Europe Campaign
chapters.summary: Winning the Europe Campaign on each difficulty, as other nations, and conquering all of Europe.

chapters.title: The Peninsular Campaign
chapters.summary: Winning the Peninsular Campaign as France, Spain or Britain, capturing and liberating regions, and pro-French sentiment.

chapters.title: Historical Battles
chapters.summary: Playing historical land battles and winning Silver or Gold in them.

chapters.title: Campaign Feats
chapters.summary: Regions, allies, protectorates, approval, trade, assassinations, duels, generals, diplomacy, special campaign challenges, starting your first game and total time played.

chapters.title: Land and Sea Battles
chapters.summary: Single-player campaign land and naval battles, boarding, and battles won with special army make-ups.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Battles
chapters.summary: Online land and naval battles and matches: wins, streaks, every faction and skill-rating challenges. Needs a network connection, if the servers still run.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Campaigns
chapters.summary: Playing and winning campaigns against another player. Needs a network connection, if the servers still run.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 14983); RAWG also has separate Gold Edition, Imperial Edition and "Napoleon: Total War - The Peninsular Campaign" (id 40294, released 2010-06-22) entries. No steamMatches by exact name; the store list app 34030 is "Total War: NAPOLEON – Definitive Edition", the edition on sale, and its schema is named "ValveTestApp34070". 71 Steam achievements, none hidden. Chapters come from achievement themes because a strategy game has no story path. Achievements that say "a match" are counted as multiplayer, which is our reading; "Win 10 decisive victories", "Win 10 land battles", "Board 5 ships" and the light-infantry battle do not say single or multiplayer, so they sit in Land and Sea Battles. "Win Egypt Campaign as Ottomans" and the Europe Campaign wins as Russia, Austria, Prussia and England do not say MP, so they sit in the single-player campaign chapters. The Peninsular Campaign chapter takes its name from the achievements and the RAWG entry. StrategyWiki has a page under "Napoleon: Total War" at completion stage 0. Written subpages: Table of Contents (about 320 characters) and Factions (about 270); Controls, Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. totalwar.fandom.com answers the API under "Napoleon: Total War" with about 94 linked articles (factions, the Italy, Egypt and Europe campaigns, battles); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
